doubts.note: 'Every act above falls inside them, except those the story shows refused for exactly that reason' is not true as written. The card sent as the video is 45,099 bytes, under the Videos page's 'File size: Between 75kb and 500MB', and the story fails it for its format, not its size; the 6.2 GB master is refused at 5 GB ('Maximum allowed Videos size is 5GB'), a ceiling the paragraph does not list beside its 500 MB. The page puts both 'file size too large' and 'unsupported file format' under PROCESSING_FAILED and does not say where the floor is checked, so no documented answer is contradicted and no item of the bar is met; a card over 75 KB and the 5 GB named would make the sentence true.
'upload URLs and media URLs thirty' (days) is on no page read: the Images page says only that 'all URLs have an expiration time'. No act leans on it.

New in this outline: the still is posted while Aaron's video processes. It reads as one person's morning (his own post, then the page's), the switch of Post as goes one way, and the composer keeping his words and file is what a person would see. The outline says the Posts tab 'lists the still and the page's launch post above the teaser'; the life's step for the tab (77) names and expects only the launch post above the teaser, so the still on the tab is told here and not walked. The feed's words while a video processes and its reloading are the twin's, on no page read.

The gone post answers Mira twice (sent to join signed out, then 'cannot be displayed' once a member): one cause in two stages of LinkedIn's own redirect, with the join between, so not read as the same cause drawn twice. Two passwords are refused in the act, Aaron's mistyped and Mira's five characters: two people, two rules, each shown. Why a dry-run check's link goes to someone outside the studio is not told, and the check post is up only between the sender's post and its delete. What LinkedIn asks of a new member after the join form (a check of the email) is left out.

The story's sender posts to no feed, deletes, cleans up at exit, uploads images, posts an article and sends a cover and captions; media's senders/linkedin.mjs at f6a2a08 does none of these (it uploads one video and posts it). Each is told as the story's and the decision table names each as the life's; the launch send of act 6 is the sender's own calls.
Mira 'follows videogame.ai' before she is on LinkedIn (read as following the studio). She has a developer application two hours after joining; how her tool knows the page's URN is not told.

The launch runs on the Community Management API's Development tier, which Increasing Access gives to 'build core business use cases'; nothing the story does is forbidden by the page. The collector's use of the day's quota is told, not walked, and why the sender looks over the page's posts is not said; the list holds the still, posted by hand, so it is no read-back.
The sender's first three sittings each meet a failure (6.2 GB, the expired token, the card as a video): three causes, each shown, months and a day apart; not a run.
